what: Case 6 cannot produce context file outside allowed roots
scenario_or_breakage: `append_context_file()` always adds `--allow-root "$(dirname "$path")"` for every forwarded context file (plan UPDATED section; current scripts/launch-claude-review.sh:99-102). Explicit `--context-files` outside PLUGIN_ROOT/SESSION_ROOT therefore succeeds via widened roots, not exit 2. Additionally `$TMPROOT` is SESSION_ROOT when `--output "$TMPROOT/out.txt"` (scripts/launch-claude-subprocess.sh:94), so files under `$TMPROOT` are already in-bounds.
suggested_fix: Replace case 6 with a positive allow-root propagation test: context file under a separate mktemp dir, invoke with `--context-files`, assert exit 0. Optionally add a separate stderr-propagation case using an explicit symlink path expecting `invalid context file` (not outside-roots).
